summary: TotalEnergies SE files a Form 6-K disclosing a series of routine disclosures including share buyback transactions for May 25-29, 2026, with total volume 1,767,146 shares at weighted average price €76.39 per share, totaling €134,999,815.60. The filing also covers a capital increase reserved for employees, an entry into the Bab Gas Cap Concession in UAE, and methane emission reduction data. No special-situation transaction such as acquisition, divestiture, or going-private is announced. It is an ordinary periodic report with no structural event.
